name: Stock State
query:
SELECT 
    sle.item_code,
    sle.warehouse,

    -- Sum of movements AFTER last zero
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN sle.posting_datetime > (
                SELECT z.posting_datetime
                FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` z
                WHERE z.actual_qty = 0
                AND z.item_code = sle.item_code
                AND z.warehouse = sle.warehouse
                ORDER BY z.posting_datetime DESC
                LIMIT 1
            )
            THEN sle.actual_qty
            ELSE 0
        END
    )
    +
    IFNULL((
        SELECT z.qty_after_transaction
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` z
        WHERE z.actual_qty = 0
        AND z.item_code = sle.item_code
        AND z.warehouse = sle.warehouse
        ORDER BY z.posting_datetime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS final_qty,

    (
        SELECT z.posting_datetime
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` z
        WHERE z.actual_qty = 0
        AND z.item_code = sle.item_code
        AND z.warehouse = sle.warehouse
        ORDER BY z.posting_datetime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS last_zero_datetime

FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
WHERE sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s
GROUP BY sle.item_code, sle.warehouse

name: Stock State Lightweight
query:
SELECT 
    sle.item_code,
    sle.warehouse,
    sle.qty_after_transaction AS final_qty
FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        item_code,
        warehouse,
        MAX(posting_datetime) AS last_dt
    FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
    WHERE warehouse = %(warehouse)s
      AND is_cancelled = 0
    GROUP BY item_code, warehouse
) latest
ON sle.item_code = latest.item_code
AND sle.warehouse = latest.warehouse
AND sle.posting_datetime = latest.last_dt
WHERE sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s
  AND sle.is_cancelled = 0;
